label: ercot98 np6 hsl fullspan
definition: ERCOT-98: full-span re-solve of the ercot97 keeper config on two measured-input alignment fixes - (1) 2023 HSL swapped UMass->published NP6 GEO (NP4-742/745; delivered matches EIA-930, loader footprint reconciliation now a no-op), (2) ASPLANNP433 AS-plan requirements CPT->CST clock conversion (evening reserve step-down ran 1h late through every DST season). No config/knob changes (rules 11/13/16).
market_story: Wind/solar dispatch against ERCOT's own published NP6 uncurtailed potential (measured HSL bound; delivered basis matches EIA-930, endogenous curtailment ~5.6 vs reported 6.0 TWh in 2023). Merchant gas CCs run as committed units: the P1-native commitment bridge holds them at the measured 0.574 LSL through evening gaps shorter than a DA operating day because a restart costs more than riding the trough — commitment physics, not residual-buying. ST_GAS steamers carry the season-resolved net-load reliability drag that keeps aging steam online into summer peaks the way ERCOT reliability practice does. Coal PRB/lignite ride shoulder troughs on the take-or-pay fuel-passthrough sigmoid. CT peakers clear on the measured DAM cleared-share offer boundary in tight net-load bins (1.5-1.7% of load, under the C8 materiality floor). Batteries follow the measured AS-award reservation with the AS-to-energy deployment floor at the evening net-load ramp. Reserve holdout is the measured AS plan — now on the correct CST clock — minus the measured Load-Resource RRS and battery AS credits, priced through the pre-RTC+B non-releasable withholding design (rigid ECRS through 2024-07-31, the IMM-documented no-price-release design).
